blocks.value: Every listed company publishes an Annual Report that explains its business performance, financial results, risks and future plans.
Imagine This: At the end of every school year, students receive a report card summarizing their performance. An Annual Report is the company's report card.
An Annual Report usually includes the Chairman's Message, Management Discussion, Financial Statements, Auditor's Report, Corporate Governance Report and Notes to the Accounts.
Before investing in a company, many experienced investors read at least the business overview, management discussion and financial statements from its Annual Report.
You don't need to read every page. Start with the business overview, risks and financial highlights.

blocks.question: What is the main purpose of an Annual Report?
choices: To summarize the company's yearly performance.
